decision.summary: The Federal Reserve lowered the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to a target range of 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent.

changes.quote: In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed lowered the interest rate range in response to global economic uncertainties and inflation that remains below the target level.

changes.quote: Although household spending has been rising at a strong pace, business fixed investment and exports remain weak.
changes.explanation: The Committee noted a split in the economy, where consumer spending is strong, but businesses are investing and exporting less.

changes.quote: On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and inflation for items other than food and energy are running below 2 percent.
changes.explanation: Inflation gauges continue to run underneath the central bank's symmetric 2 percent objective.

tone_quotes.quote: In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent.
On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and inflation for items other than food and energy are running below 2 percent.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 15.13% APR, a 25 bp cut lowers monthly interest by about $1.04.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 1.78% and moved -6 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 3.69% would fall by about $10.15 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $15.00 a year less in interest.
Unemployment was 3.5%, and employers added an average of 176k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 1.7% over the past year while core PCE inflation was 1.6% against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 4.8% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield moved -3 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved 0.33%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.16% on the day.

card.whats_next: The statement signals that future rate decisions will depend on incoming data regarding employment, inflation, and global developments. The Committee will continue assessing the appropriate path for the target range as economic conditions evolve.
